name: omniroute
description: Connects Kimi Code to a running OmniRoute AI gateway over MCP, including routing, providers, combos, cache, compression, and memory tools.

interface.shortDescription: OmniRoute MCP tools for Kimi Code
interface.longDescription: Connect Kimi Code to an existing OmniRoute instance over Streamable HTTP. Uses OMNIROUTE_API_KEY from the environment when authentication is required; no credentials are stored in this plugin.

omniroute.description: Routing, provider, combo, cache, compression, memory, and other gateway tools
